questions.question:
Write one line per node to `/tmp/exam/q1/nodes.txt` on `cka-q1`, sorted by node name, in the format `<node-name> <InternalIP>`.

Use `kubectl` output options (`-o jsonpath` or `-o custom-columns`); the file must contain nothing else.

verification.description: nodes.txt lists every node with its InternalIP, sorted by name

questions.question:
Pods in the namespace `sales` can no longer resolve any name since a `default-deny-egress` NetworkPolicy was added (test: `kubectl exec -n sales sales-client -- nslookup kubernetes.default`).

Keep `default-deny-egress` and add a NetworkPolicy `allow-dns` in `sales` that lets **all** Pods of the namespace send DNS traffic (UDP and TCP port `53`) to the cluster DNS Pods (label `k8s-app=kube-dns` in the namespace `kube-system`), and nothing else.

verification.description: allow-dns allows only DNS to kube-dns, default-deny kept
Name resolution works again from sales-client

questions.question: The Deployment `inventory` in the namespace `quota-lab` has `0` Pods. Find out why (look at its ReplicaSet's events), then fix the **Deployment** so its container has requests `cpu: 100m`, `memory: 64Mi` and limits `cpu: 200m`, `memory: 128Mi`. Do not change or delete the ResourceQuota. Both replicas must be available.

verification.description: Quota unchanged and resources set on the Deployment
Both replicas are available

questions.question:
In the namespace `shop`, the Service `shop` sends traffic to the Deployment `shop-v1` (3 replicas, labels `app=shop`, `version=v1`).

Start a canary: create a Deployment `shop-v2` with `1` replica of `nginx:1.27` whose Pods are labeled `app=shop` and `version=v2`, so that the Service sends it about a quarter of the traffic. Do not modify the Service or `shop-v1`.

verification.description: shop-v2 is a 1-replica nginx:1.27 canary labeled app=shop,version=v2
Service unchanged and sends traffic to 4 Pods

questions.question: A legacy database runs outside the cluster at `10.0.0.50:5432`. In the namespace `integrations`, create a Service `legacy-db` on port `5432` **without a selector**, and point it at that address manually, so Pods can reach the database as `legacy-db.integrations`.

verification.description: legacy-db has no selector and listens on 5432
legacy-db points to 10.0.0.50:5432

questions.question:
The Secret `app-secrets` in the namespace `vault` holds the keys `api-token` and `db-password`.

Run a Pod `vault-agent` (image `busybox:1.36`, command `sleep 3600`) that mounts **only** the key `api-token`, as the file `/etc/app/token`, with file mode `0400`. `db-password` must not be visible in the Pod.

verification.description: Pod mounts only api-token at /etc/app/token with mode 0400
The file contains the token and db-password is absent

questions.question: In the namespace `batch`, create a Job `batch-import` (image `busybox:1.36`, command `sh -c 'echo importing; sleep 2'`) that runs `6` successful completions, at most `2` Pods at a time, retries at most `3` times, and is deleted automatically `10800` seconds after it finishes. The Job must complete.

verification.description: Job spec: 6 completions, parallelism 2, backoffLimit 3, ttl 10800
All 6 completions succeeded

questions.question:
Build the permissions of the monitoring system with an **aggregated** ClusterRole:

1. ClusterRole `monitoring-aggregate` with an `aggregationRule` that collects every ClusterRole labeled `rbac.ckx.io/aggregate-to-monitoring=true`
2. ClusterRole `monitoring-pods` (with that label): `get`, `list`, `watch` on `pods` and `services`
3. ClusterRole `monitoring-nodes` (with that label): `get`, `list` on `nodes`
4. ClusterRoleBinding `prometheus-monitoring` that grants `monitoring-aggregate` to the ServiceAccount `prometheus` in the namespace `monitoring`

verification.description: monitoring-aggregate aggregates the labeled ClusterRoles
prometheus gets exactly the aggregated read access

questions.question:
In the namespace `canary`, the Gateway `edge` (class `ckx-gateway`) and the Services `store-v1` and `store-v2` (port `80`) already exist. There is no gateway controller, so only the resources are graded.

Create an HTTPRoute `store` attached to `edge` for the hostname `store.example.local` that splits all traffic between `store-v1` (weight `90`) and `store-v2` (weight `10`).

verification.description: HTTPRoute store splits 90/10 between store-v1 and store-v2

questions.question:
A Kustomize base for the app `api` is in `/tmp/exam/q10/base` on `cka-q10`. Create the overlay `/tmp/exam/q10/overlays/staging` that:

- deploys into the namespace `staging` (it exists) with the name prefix `staging-`
- uses the image `nginx:1.27` instead of the base's `nginx:1.25` (without editing the base)
- runs `2` replicas of the Deployment
- adds the label `env=staging` to all resources

Apply it with `kubectl apply -k`.

verification.description: Base untouched, overlay renders the staging variant
staging-api Deployment and Service are applied and running

questions.question:
A Helm chart is in `/tmp/exam/q11/webapp` on `cka-q11`, with production values in `/tmp/exam/q11/values-prod.yaml`.

1. Install it as the release `webapp` in the namespace `helm-apps` (create it) using the production values
2. Upgrade the release to set `image.tag=1.27`, **keeping** the production values
3. The new version is rejected by QA: roll the release back to revision `1`

verification.description: Revision 2 upgraded the image and kept the production values
Release rolled back to revision 1

questions.question:
The node `k3d-cluster-agent-0` is tainted `maintenance=planned:NoSchedule` for a maintenance window. Drain it (DaemonSet Pods may stay). The drain gets stuck because of the PodDisruptionBudget `ledger-pdb` in the namespace `ledger`.

Change `ledger-pdb` (do not delete it) so that it allows one Pod of `ledger` to be unavailable at a time (`maxUnavailable: 1`), then complete the drain. `ledger` must end with `2` Ready Pods, none on `k3d-cluster-agent-0`.

verification.description: ledger-pdb uses maxUnavailable 1
Node drained and ledger healthy elsewhere

questions.question:
The Deployment `report-gen` in the namespace `reporting` is in `CrashLoopBackOff`.

1. Save the **error line** from the logs of the crashed container to `/tmp/exam/q13/error.txt` on `cka-q13`
2. Fix the Deployment so that it prints `starting report generator` and then runs `sleep 3600`

verification.description: error.txt contains the error from the logs
report-gen runs the corrected command

questions.question:
In the namespace `archive`, the Pod `archive` is `Pending` because its PVC `archive-data` uses a StorageClass that does not exist.

Make it work with the StorageClass `local-path`: the PVC must keep its name and its size (`1Gi`, `ReadWriteOnce`), and the Pod `archive` (same image and command, mounting `archive-data` at `/data`) must be Running.

verification.description: archive-data uses local-path, 1Gi RWO, and is Bound
Pod archive runs with archive-data at /data

questions.question:
Production Deployments must never run a single replica. Using a `ValidatingAdmissionPolicy` (no webhook):

1. Create the policy `require-two-replicas` that applies to `CREATE` and `UPDATE` of `apps/v1` `deployments` and only accepts them when `spec.replicas >= 2`
2. Create the binding `require-two-replicas-binding` with `validationActions: [Deny]` that applies the policy only in namespaces labeled `env=prod`

The namespaces `payments-prod` (`env=prod`) and `payments-dev` exist. Verify with `kubectl create deployment ... --replicas=1 --dry-run=server`.

verification.description: Policy and binding are configured as requested
1 replica is denied in prod, allowed in dev; 2 replicas allowed in prod

questions.question: Write the names of all Pods in the namespace `observability`, **oldest first** (by creation time), one per line, to `/tmp/exam/q16/pods-by-age.txt` on `cka-q16`. The file must contain only the Pod names.

verification.description: pods-by-age.txt lists the Pods oldest first
